"fr86-u040-b0032", "text": "—Alors, madamoiselle, comment expliquez-vous les circonstances à votre charge?", "sha256": "c43541ac66409726d61da2d53626a8cd0444f9b8de0f849f8e31e33a6d9c852b", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [2352], "source_xml_sha256": "a5006851e6c28c2e03fc80dae27054ee7d5acdc50872a72ad6e72cc143c0355e", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u040-b0033", "text": "—Hélas, monseigneur! je ne sais.", "sha256": "adf8067d5ec4e2074578db9193555628d0a76390ec24b224a6c9bac1eaa405ae", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [2353], "source_xml_sha256": "e0df77203f3d5ff8d5422f337fec0a0355dba2c7111c787adf207ed0b2e25cbb", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u040-b0034", "text": "—Vous niez donc?", "sha256": "b6d01f318bf2c27329bf1f85ca3f51dc46b436da5ad72daca40d99714f62a784", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [2354], "source_xml_sha256": "c8b80835c146f842d146461ea57b182f0fa1c9bc4917a9997ab8695186488430", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u040-b0035", "text": "—Tout!", "sha256": "5e98d4c4f276b8bebe53e245a77047ad2e48b5b3ad610de2a9ebe8efa670dbcc", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [2355], "source_xml_sha256": "46e45f978d4542d645cd49e551325f27cccfaf25c3647f536047c3925a850b3d", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u040-b0036", "text": "—Faites», dit Charmolue à Pierrat.", "sha256": "3218cb5cf9b33cb8c0fca1a494ffd756d1771e9543d84b9557d154206561e319", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [2356], "source_xml_sha256": "62545f9c85ddb6bc589755192f68776d1bb604022776afe1d2dfe7548de0c62e", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u040-b0037", "text": "Pierrat tourna la poignée du cric, le brodequin se resserra, et la malheureuse poussa un de ces horribles cris qui n'ont d'orthographe dans aucune langue humaine.", "sha256": "bcaaab15620c92421fe455dbdc6d814990330594e308344d42b568647c7d0881", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [2357], "source_xml_sha256": "6d093fcb48fee21a093981b0eb1586faa8725509d03e11a27ba0bcaf8d6e3e27", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u040-b0038", "text": "«Arrêtez, dit Charmolue à Pierrat.—Avouez-vous? dit-il à l'égyptienne.", "sha256": "111246e45d7b1a362028a701efe69b6692fb7caac5b3e8d67e0199124a3efcc4", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [2358], "source_xml_sha256": "4220ee1051e8c237a2fdc1a15a898df7a23e5f814105f1aac1c054703a32658b", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u040-b0039", "text": "—Tout! cria la misérable fille. J'avoue! j'avoue! grâce!»", "sha256": "690f8e4bcde42189fe6b68c90eafde7376d45941738a0fa7a51c2551a9e6a34b", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [2359], "source_xml_sha256": "766982b90b1f3353817b83161d18799bef543baa2aefa0b7229429843b79fc41", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u040-b0040", "text": "Elle n'avait pas calculé ses forces en affrontant la question. Pauvre enfant dont la vie jusqu'alors avait été si joyeuse, si suave, si douce, la première douleur l'avait vaincue.", "sha256": "6cd5170ee483ac9e2f26b49b30c673492c577a2b13e28cb5ac73093f3e3bf564", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [2360], "source_xml_sha256": "83fa9059398ba110242410e3c2d2f0d76e3dc31a2b93186fcb84310f65e93ae3", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u040-b0041", "text": "«L'humanité m'oblige à vous dire, observa le procureur du roi, qu'en avouant c'est la mort que vous devez attendre.", "sha256": "fd51f20a5c83beacfc9ee8eab994baf475c2e034b3f01737b766bd9ef9fa4d42", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [2361], "source_xml_sha256": "dcab7b22a4a43b4a31136cc4e6d9f7a23eea31a80c07dc7e9dd801b794f06ec1", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u040-b0042", "text": "—Je l'espère bien», dit-elle. Et elle retomba sur le lit de cuir, mourante, pliée en deux, se laissant pendre à la courroie bouclée sur sa poitrine.", "sha256": "875c9a126bb761ab28557a0fb3489c886a8b6fdcf8610653452a493f30f69434", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [2362], "source_xml_sha256": "7cbe57f0c5753eb44ec1270f727d97adc22750bd607eb0381d377dec085b9d79", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u040-b0043", "text": "«Sus, ma belle, soutenez-vous un peu, dit maître Pierrat en la relevant. Vous avez l'air du mouton d'or qui est au cou de monsieur de Bourgogne.»", "sha256": "abde0f78cce75fad87fd539f66f8f5af2359f0c4a2c3f67049e9c38f653ca1b8", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [2363], "source_xml_sha256": "4d7443f85317f5f51e64ee91b41c06d288868acadd0567196d07339b2030327b", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u040-b0044", "text": "Jacques Charmolue éleva la voix.", "sha256": "d1b6ed4dbd898be9bb734456536a95e4def928b0b59361c21336bdf32257e147", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [2364], "source_xml_sha256": "38638f7e0ab9c425ab61492d5ea4dbf2c9e291eaf77650faa92b280faaaca716", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u040-b0045", "text": "«Greffier, écrivez.—Jeune fille bohème, vous avouez votre participation aux agapes, sabbats et maléfices de l'enfer, avec les larves, les masques et les stryges? Répondez.", "sha256": "e7f2b951191d424c593be3479f9adcc941fa443ef8e7a978b60a248e59d8da7e", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [2365], "source_xml_sha256": "7a29b9e778e01bbc03b80d1a398cf281e58af437c585865192201b02197a37db", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u040-b0046", "text": "—Oui, dit-elle, si bas que sa parole se perdait dans son souffle.", "sha256": "16947f7952c733a1637b02c4863c325ba72302b2eefd5249488a2f69f9b44bdb", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [2366], "source_xml_sha256": "f8790b018973b24a3bc60e7de18beb1ee6c908af9aff24e2fd76081f97570405", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u040-b0047", "text": "—Vous avouez avoir vu le bélier que Belzébuth fait paraître dans les nuées pour rassembler le sabbat, et qui n'est vu que des sorciers?", "sha256": "ebbc98fd7c20c2466cc853dd0240bb7a6ea4bad345c0a4dec351222641b58b1d", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [2367], "source_xml_sha256": "1ed0aff4aa43e6a3d0255dc4df44dd56bc7611ffde828df59905f1e73cf567ff", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u040-b0048", "text": "—Oui.", "sha256": "6f532a28c15283cbc84b6867f11c5be7c7c15a90b7d0887492a8bec5c829db39", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [2368], "source_xml_sha256": "4cba2da00e33e9050328b3f950a6f8e1a1768e4b59057c05bce5ac2de938e3fc", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u040-b0049", "text": "—Vous confessez avoir adoré les têtes de Bophomet, ces abominables idoles des templiers?", "sha256": "8b67ae775c8912cb81c42d60ed249d6c0944762931cefbc7ddd5db6fdc83221b", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [2369], "source_xml_sha256": "1cf96a5abffd5085fb1bb657c5725277ce8661c27aafa5649ae99ae31eebb1b1", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u040-b0050", "text": "—Oui.", "sha256": "6f532a28c15283cbc84b6867f11c5be7c7c15a90b7d0887492a8bec5c829db39", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [2370], "source_xml_sha256": "4cba2da00e33e9050328b3f950a6f8e1a1768e4b59057c05bce5ac2de938e3fc", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u040-b0051", "text": "—Avoir eu commerce habituel avec le diable sous la forme d'une chèvre familière, jointe au procès?", "sha256": "620140d2f1d4a6f3b955dafd1aa4fd144efe28d79ffd859d8947fda777d1c795", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [2371], "source_xml_sha256": "5866088f8f001bab5adad542a53dab4b454e72e29c3e74b5f18a5276a4ca4735", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u040-b0052", "text": "—Oui.", "sha256": "6f532a28c15283cbc84b6867f11c5be7c7c15a90b7d0887492a8bec5c829db39", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [2372], "source_xml_sha256": "4cba2da00e33e9050328b3f950a6f8e1a1768e4b59057c05bce5ac2de938e3fc", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u040-b0053", "text": "—Enfin, vous avouez et confessez avoir, à l'aide du démon, et du fantôme vulgairement appelé le moine bourru, dans la nuit du vingt-neuvième mars dernier, meurtri et assassiné un capitaine nommé Phoebus de Châteaupers?»", "sha256": "c2058b0a10f1f3f6350d8d0c0f97582a0c4eaba673a6029ef0964e304b9b264b", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [2373], "source_xml_sha256": "d9d8f61bcbd54fe7dc42a61fba9028985758ad3e7cb1f872b6596afb05aca332", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u040-b0054", "text": "Elle leva sur le magistrat ses grands yeux fixes, et répondit comme machinalement, sans convulsion et sans secousse: «Oui.» Il était évident que tout était brisé en elle.", "sha256": "aaf5376e796f9a6ddecb27a17fcbb63281bafaff512dfce64c7790ddc9709820", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [2374], "source_xml_sha256": "69e566252220d10a75acf0b72d0093cb70c699f7f6fed23b832a9a3723b9ba4e", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u040-b0055", "text": "«Écrivez, greffier», dit Charmolue. Et s'adressant aux tortionnaires: «Qu'on détache la prisonnière, et qu'on la ramène à l'audience.»", "sha256": "631022a687ca57c2ac4b122c7b401074926785c10d4972d7dd25a378d81a75e2", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [2375], "source_xml_sha256": "57a135a51c62d57b07bb1239c4b1771d3801a54a4d310ea03c49d944d2ee44fa", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u040-b0056", "text": "Quand la prisonnière fut [[I]]déchaussée[[/I]], le procureur en cour d'église examina son pied encore engourdi par la douleur.", "sha256": "ddee8239fbd3aba56cd22a05d779f2fe1dc97bdec951c29f0024027b2abb19b9", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [2376], "source_xml_sha256": "8464e2dbac8cdae37a7590798c878f73cc7dfe48064cf31228aa4a84858b64e1", "emphasis_spans": 1, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u040-b0057", "text": "«Allons! dit-il, il n'y a pas grand mal. Vous avez crié à temps. Vous pourriez encore danser, la belle!»", "sha256": "a06c58ea79eed3bc959be0ebde8ca98a99e478d6b67a66671fa5a322ffb33113", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [2377], "source_xml_sha256": "436ddae1fe884ddf1b58dbfcc724dae792f44dc800fa3a2196e3295aa27f715b", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u040-b0058", "text": "Puis il se tourna vers ses acolytes de l'officialité. «Voilà enfin la justice éclairée! Cela soulage, messieurs! Mademoiselle nous rendra ce témoignage, que nous avons agi avec toute la douceur possible.»", "sha256": "352b02f8c9e393eb7628252871f9f20f7a2c22ec5d4bf9179717f515ef2cd343", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [2378], "source_xml_sha256": "fadaf1b5e945da8f9f16f7ac6111f42215fa9d072a2ca3f2f6b0fb63d8026457", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}]}
